name: agevolt-fe
description: AgeVolt frontend doplnok pre Codex, ktory smeruje agentov na zivu FE knowledge base, web-portal pravidla a business-logic bootstrap.

interface.shortDescription: Frontend KB router for AgeVolt projects.
interface.longDescription: AgeVolt FE plugin for Codex. It does not contain a static rule copy; it routes agents to current AGENTS.md, knowledge_base, registry.yaml, and business-logic rules from local repositories.
defaultPrompt: Load AgeVolt FE rules before working in the web-portal repository.
Review a Dynamic DataGrid V4 view or preset against the live KB.
Refactor a static settings page using the AgeVolt FE settings rules.
